title: Print Numbers in Given Range

content.problemStatement: Print all the numbers from given range.

solution.approach: Print all numbers from given range [A, B] inclusive separated by space.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Iterate from start A to end B inclusive and output space-separated values.

hints: Read start and end bounds A and B.
Iterate from A up to B.
learningObjectives: Handle arbitrary lower and upper bounds.
